title: The Kluge Center Remembers Colin Powell and Madeleine Albright

claim: Former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright was a speaker at a special conference that commemorated the 25th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution and its key figure, Václav Havel.

evidence.quote: A special conference commemorated the 25th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution and its key figure, Václav Havel, who later became president of Czechoslovakia and the Czech Republic. Speakers included Michael Zantovsky, former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and Sen. John McCain.

Senator John McCain and former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright join former Ambassador of the Czech Republic to the United Kingdom Michael Žantovský in a discussion on the political importance of Václav Havel, November 19, 2014.

notes: Conference held by the John W. Kluge Center.

claim: Madeleine Albright was a friend of Václav Havel.

evidence.quote: Two of Václav Havel’s friends in attendance were Senator John McCain and former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright

claim: Madeleine Albright offered personal recollections of Václav Havel’s leadership during the Velvet Revolution, which peacefully brought an end to over four decades of Communism in Czechoslovakia.

evidence.quote: Two of Václav Havel’s friends in attendance were Senator John McCain and former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, both of whom offered personal recollections of Havel’s leadership during the Velvet Revolution, which peacefully brought an end to over four decades of Communism in Czechoslovakia.

notes: Recollections offered at the Kluge Center conference on Havel's legacy.

claim: In 2015, the inaugural Daniel K. Inouye Lecture at the Library of Congress featured Madeleine Albright and Colin Powell.

evidence.quote: In 2015, the Inaugural Daniel K. Inouye Lecture featured Madeleine Albright and Colin Powell.
Madeleine Albright and Colin Powell will inaugurate the Library's Daniel K. Inouye Distinguished Lecture Series on July 8.
The Library of Congress today announced a distinguished lecture series

notes: Press release dated 2015-06-17 announced the July 8 lecture; the 2022 Kluge Center post confirms it took place in 2015.
